proved_scoped: Exact symbolic existential projection may be applied to discovered native modules before any shared-boundary enumeration when the complete module factor matches an already sealed projection language.

Globally UNATE modules admit exact internal-variable elimination by retaining only boundary-only clauses; exact 2CNF projection is obtained by sealed Davis-Putnam elimination and remains polynomially bounded in distinct width<=2 clauses.
The rewritten conjunction is existentially equivalent to the original module mosaic, while unsupported modules are preserved unchanged.

If the parent cycle-cut/forest compiler returns SAT after projection, eliminated internal assignments can be recovered by conditioning each original native module on returned boundary values and invoking its native polynomial solver.
